headline: Fed Rate Hike & Future Hikes
detail: The Fed raising rates and signaling more could pressure growth stocks, especially those on margin. Lowering yields, however, can sometimes be a tailwind for tech.
rec: Monitor how your leveraged holdings react to interest rate policy shifts.

headline: AI Oversight Concerns
